verdict.rationale: A hands-on community commenter reports that AnythingLLM supports TTS and STT, enough to build a voice chatbot, which covers spoken replies and transcribed input. First-party evidence covers only local meeting transcription, which is related but is not voice interaction with the assistant. missing for 10: first-party docs on voice input/dictation in chat, documented spoken replies (TTS) in the chat UI, any evidence of live real-time voice conversation, and independent corroboration beyond a single comment.
